How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for CSIR CGCRI Research Associate - I Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 29-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Associate - I position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 29 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate - I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a PhD in Science/Engineering or M.E./M.Tech in Chemical Engineering/Chemical Technology/Material Science & Engineering with 3 years of research experience and at least one SCI journal publication.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years, with relaxations applicable for SC/ST/OBC/Female/PH candidates.

faq.question: Q4. How will the candidates be selected for the Research Associate - I position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves document verification followed by a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate - I role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive Rs. 58,000/- per month plus HRA @ 30%.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Research Associate - I position.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Central Glass & Ceramic Research Institute, Kolkata.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs are required.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from other states apply for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates from all eligible backgrounds can apply as long as they meet the specified qualifications and age criteria.
